import inspect
from solution import check_isosceles


def test_issue_example_6_8_12_false():
    """Example assert check_isosceles(6,8,12)==False."""
    # 6!=8, 8!=12, 6!=12 => scalene => False
    assert check_isosceles(6, 8, 12) == False


def test_issue_xy_equal_true():
    """Isosceles when x equals y so (7,7,10) is True."""
    # 7==7 => at least two equal => True
    assert check_isosceles(7, 7, 10) == True


def test_issue_yz_equal_true():
    """Isosceles when y equals z so (10,7,7) is True."""
    # 7==7 => at least two equal => True
    assert check_isosceles(10, 7, 7) == True


def test_issue_xz_equal_true():
    """Isosceles when x equals z so (7,10,7) is True."""
    # 7==7 => at least two equal => True
    assert check_isosceles(7, 10, 7) == True


def test_issue_scalene_3_4_5_false():
    """Scalene triangle (3,4,5) is not isosceles so False."""
    # 3!=4, 4!=5, 3!=5 => scalene => False
    assert check_isosceles(3, 4, 5) == False


def test_issue_scalene_2_3_4_false():
    """Scalene triangle (2,3,4) is not isosceles so False."""
    # 2!=3, 3!=4, 2!=4 => scalene => False
    assert check_isosceles(2, 3, 4) == False


def test_issue_float_isosceles_true():
    """Isosceles with floats (5.0,5.0,8.0) is True."""
    # 5.0==5.0 => at least two equal => True
    assert check_isosceles(5.0, 5.0, 8.0) == True


def test_issue_large_isosceles_true():
    """Isosceles with large sides (1000000,1000000,999999) is True."""
    # 1000000==1000000 => at least two equal => True
    assert check_isosceles(1000000, 1000000, 999999) == True


def test_contract_callable():
    """Function check_isosceles(x,y,z) must exist in solution."""
    # callable(check_isosceles) is True => True
    assert callable(check_isosceles) == True


def test_contract_three_parameters():
    """Function check_isosceles must take three parameters x,y,z."""
    # parameters x,y,z => count 3
    assert len(inspect.signature(check_isosceles).parameters) == 3


def test_contract_isosceles_order_independent():
    """Isosceles result must not depend on side order."""
    # 5==5 => True
    assert check_isosceles(5, 5, 8) == True
    # 5==5 permuted => True
    assert check_isosceles(8, 5, 5) == True


def test_contract_scalene_order_independent():
    """Scalene result must not depend on side order."""
    # 6!=8, 8!=12, 6!=12 => False
    assert check_isosceles(6, 8, 12) == False
    # 8!=12, 12!=6, 8!=6 permuted => False
    assert check_isosceles(8, 12, 6) == False
